text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.1943 for the Software Engineer / SRE position. The strongest evidence includes their experience with "AWS", "Django" for scripting, and "Kubernetes" for containerisation and devops. Key gaps include a lack of experience in spring, infrastructure as code, and ci/cd, as well as falling short of the expected years of experience. Despite the low fit, missing must-have requirements, and a location mismatch, this application has been escalated for further review.
